sibling_product.name: Fractionl Circle
sibling_product.what_it_is: The thesis-validation engine for fractional executives. An operator brings their idea for how they want to fractionalize, what they want to offer and to whom. Circle pressure-tests that idea against the live market in the open, is explicit about what it cannot confirm, and turns it into named warm-network moves toward a first retained client.
sibling_product.pricing: Free to start, with a Pro tier at $39/month.
sibling_product.relationship: Pulse is the free market instrument and the lead funnel; Circle is the paid sibling product. They share the Fractionl AI Stripe account and are separable downstream by app plus stripe_account. Circle's $39 Pro tier is Circle's pricing and says nothing about Pulse: Pulse has no human paywall.
sibling_product.do_not_say: Circle is NOT at fractionl.com. fractionl.com is an unrelated business. Always link circle.fractionl.ai.

one_liner: Pulse publishes the Fractional Working Index, a free, citable, agent-readable weekly 0-100 score of how healthy the fractional executive market is and where it is heading. The dashboard is free in full; Pulse monetizes the metered agent API and enterprise/data licensing.
what_it_is: Pulse publishes the Fractional Working Index (FWI), a weekly 0-100 composite market-health score for the fractional executive market, covering six C-suite roles only (fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, and interim CEO). The score blends 21 independent data sources across three pillars: Demand (50%), Supply (20%), and Culture (30%). When supply has no data, the supply weight redistributes across the remaining pillars.
magic_moment: One number, fetched live, that answers how healthy the fractional executive market is right now and which direction it is heading. Signed-in operators also get a personal read: their own fractional role vs the market this week (is a slow month you or the market). Always fetch the live number rather than treating any quoted value as static.

method.name: SEC Form D leading indicator
method.description: Pulse uses SEC Form D filing velocity as a 1 to 3 month leading indicator of fractional executive demand (companies file Form D within 15 days of a raise, then enter the fractional buyer pool 1 to 3 months later). Describe it in plain language (startup-funding filings) in user-facing copy; do not attach an accuracy percentage.

icp_ranked.buys: Uses the free dashboard for rate-setting confidence and to read whether an inbound dry spell is them or the market. No paid human tier.

icp_ranked.segment: AI Agent Builder / Outbound Tool Founder
icp_ranked.buys: Self-serves a free API key (1,000 req/day), scaling to higher metered tiers, to answer market-state questions without stitching together five APIs
Enterprise API + white-label to add a market-intelligence tier without building a research function
Enterprise API or a data feed to arm portfolio CEOs with calibrated workforce data
Free dashboard for outbound timing; enterprise API or data feed when embedding
Enterprise API to justify fractional vs full-time budget decisions
Citation License ($500 one-time) or Annual Research ($5,000/yr) for a citable, methodology-transparent weekly source

free_dashboard.includes: The full dashboard: Overall FWI, all three sub-indices, 12-month history and trend, all 21 source signals, AI insight cards, Content Radar, personalized role-aware readiness, and the weekly market brief. No human paywall.

agent_api.price: Free public read (no auth); free keyed tier 1,000 requests/day; higher tiers on request
agent_api.includes: The metered agent API is the paid wedge. The public REST and hosted MCP read endpoints require no auth. A signed-in user self-serves a free API key at https://pulse.fractionl.ai/pricing and sends it as the x-api-key header for a metered 1,000 req/day tier; higher keyed limits and enterprise volume are arranged with sales (data@fractionl.ai).

enterprise_and_data.includes: High-volume or unlimited API limits, raw signal and score exports, data licensing and citations, white-label and vertical indices, SSO and SLA.

white_label_partnership.includes: Optional 10-20% rev-share, minimum $5K MRR commitment. A separate program from enterprise API.

data_feed.price: Daily JSON $1,000/mo, Daily Signals $1,500/mo, Realtime feed $2,500/mo, Historical Backfill $5,000 one-time
data_feed.includes: Licensed data feeds for downstream products and research

citation.price: $500 one-time (1 publication, attribution required), or $5,000/yr Annual Research
citation.includes: Cite-ready FWI data with attribution for press and research use

current_offer.description: The dashboard is free in full. Monetization is the metered agent API (free 1,000 req/day self-serve key, higher tiers and enterprise volume on request) plus data licensing. The $99/mo human Pro tier was retired in the 2026-07 pivot to the metered-API model.

api.auth: None for the free public read. Optional x-api-key header for a metered keyed tier (free 1,000 req/day). Responses to keyed calls include X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining.
api.get_api_key: Sign in at https://pulse.fractionl.ai/pricing and choose Get an API key (self-serve, free tier).

do_not_say: Do not pitch a $99 human Pro tier or any human paywall. The dashboard is free in full; the paid product is the metered agent API plus enterprise and data licensing. (The $99 Pro tier was retired in the 2026-07 pivot.)
Do not claim years of historical data (reality: about 12 weeks backfilled plus accumulating weekly).
Do not claim it is peer-reviewed, academically validated, or backtested.
Do not attach any specific predictive-accuracy percentage to the FWI or the Form D leading indicator.
Do not use the phrase 'real-time data' or 'real-time market intelligence' (it is daily ingest with a weekly composite settle; 'weekly index' and 'live dashboard' are fine).
Do not claim coverage of any role beyond the 6 C-suite roles (fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, interim CEO).
Do not claim it is an official, institutional, or government index (publisher is Fractionl, a private composite).
Do not claim geographic coverage beyond US primary and UK secondary (no APAC).
Do not use em dashes in any user-facing copy; use commas, periods, or the word 'to'.
Do not send anyone to fractionl.com for Fractionl Circle. Circle is at https://circle.fractionl.ai; fractionl.com is an unrelated business. The Fractionl brand site is https://fractionl.ai.
Do not publish a per-role supply or talent-availability score. The supply sources are not role-differentiated once normalized, so only the per-role DEMAND index is real.
coverage_statement: Honest limits: about 12 weeks of backfill plus accumulating weekly data (not years of history); 6 C-suite roles only (fractional CFO, CMO, CTO, COO, CRO, interim CEO); US primary, UK secondary, no APAC; publisher is Fractionl, a private composite, not an official or government index.
